desc:
Google Shopping ads and product feed setup show your products with a photo, price and store name in Google results. Ecom Swift LLC cleans the feed in Merchant Center and builds Shopping campaigns in your own Google Ads account.

## What is a Google Shopping product feed?

A Google Shopping product feed is the structured list of your products that Google reads: titles, descriptions, prices, images, availability, brand and identifiers such as GTIN. Shopping ads are built from this feed, not written by hand like a text ad. Google matches searches to your products based on what the feed says.

That is why the feed matters more than the campaign. A great campaign cannot rescue a feed full of vague titles, missing identifiers and wrong prices. Google may reject those products entirely, and the ones it accepts may show for the wrong searches.

## How feed quality shapes sales

Shoppers compare images, prices and titles at a glance before they click anything. A title that begins with the brand and ends with the material, size and color gives Google more to match and the buyer more to trust. A product with a missing image or a price that differs from the page can be disapproved, which means it simply does not appear.

Structure matters too. If your best sellers and your lowest-margin items share one pile of budget, Google will spend where clicks are cheapest, not where profit is highest. Grouping products by category or margin lets you put money where it earns.

## What a strong Shopping setup includes

- A Merchant Center account linked to your store and verified for your domain.
- Feed errors and warnings fixed: missing identifiers, mismatched prices, image issues.
- Product titles rewritten to put the words shoppers search for first.
- Correct shipping and tax settings for the countries you sell to.
- Product categories mapped to Google's own category list.
- Product groups or priority tiers based on margin or category.
- A Google Ads account linked to Merchant Center.
- Conversion tracking tested on a real checkout.
- Negative keywords to keep out irrelevant searches.
- A clear list of what we fixed and what still needs your attention.

## What we do

We connect your store to Merchant Center and read the diagnostics Google provides. We then go through the feed product by product where needed, fixing titles, images, prices, availability and identifiers. Some problems come from the store data itself, so we explain where a change must be made on your side or in your product pages.

Once the feed is healthy, we create the Shopping campaign in your Google Ads account, divide products into groups and set a starting budget. The Basic package covers a first round of fixes for a set number of products and one campaign. Standard handles a larger feed, improved titles for your key products, product groups and a shipping and tax check. Premium covers the biggest feeds, priority tiers by margin, brand protection through negative keywords and a handover call. Extra batches of products, a promotions feed and a free listings check can be added. We edit the feed, not your product pages, unless you request that separately.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Keep prices and stock in the feed matching your site.
- Use real photos on a plain background.
- Include brand, GTIN or MPN where they exist.
- Check Merchant Center diagnostics regularly.
- Separate best sellers from slow items in different groups.

**Avoid:**
- Writing titles stuffed with promotional words.
- Using images with watermarks, text overlays or logos.
- Leaving shipping costs out of the feed.
- Advertising out-of-stock items.
- Pointing products to pages that do not show the same price.

## Who it is for

This service suits an online store owner whose products are disapproved or show warnings in Merchant Center. It suits a seller with a large catalog and no time to fix titles. It also suits a store running Search ads that wants to add product-image ads alongside them.

## What we need and how to start

Send your store address and the platform it runs on. We need access to Merchant Center and Google Ads as a user or manager, and a staff or collaborator login to your store so we can read product data, never your passwords. You pay Google for clicks and agree the daily amount with us. Approval of products and ad delivery are decisions made by Google, so we fix every issue we can find, but we cannot promise outcomes.
